note: Centerline needs the same CREATE panel placement and icon as its neighbours (sketch.ellipse, sketch.conic): without them it never appeared in the CREATE panel's drop-down at all, pinned or not. Both it and the construction toggle draw their icon in the app's fixed construction orange, independently of the tab or panel accent colour.
Close the menu with Escape: a fixed canvas pixel can be inside the menu after ribbon families or pins change its position.
